title: Deviations at Kaveri Auto Parts
body: Kaveri Auto Parts Ltd. makes brake components. Its plan allows labour cost to rise by up to 2 per cent in a month as an acceptable range of deviation, because labour cost is one of the key result areas of the firm. In March, the monthly report showed that labour cost had risen by 1.5 per cent, while postal charges had risen by 15 per cent. In April, labour cost rose by 5 per cent. In the same month, one worker, Mr Ravi, fell short of his daily production target by 8 units on two days in a row, although his output for the rest of the month was on target. The production head asked the managing director to dismiss Mr Ravi at once.
